annotations.title: Analyse a name: nama nakshatra syllable and numerology

description: Checks whether a name begins with the syllable of the Moon's birth nakshatra pada (classical Avakahada rule), and scores the name and alternative spellings with Chaldean and Pythagorean numerology, Cheiro compound numbers 10-52, birth and destiny numbers, and a ranking of numbers by functional lordship for the lagna. Give date, time and place for the chart-based checks; date alone gives birth numbers only. Numerology is labelled modern, not classical.

generateVariants.description: Also score single-edit spelling variants of the first name

spellings.description: Other full-name spellings to compare, for example the passport or social media spelling
